The night of this land is not like the day.

At dusk tonight's Omen is told: it changes the whole open world until dawn. Later in the night Nightlords rise in the wild or warbands of Shadow Raiders come for the hunters: the two take turns, one night each. In the last hour, the Witching Hour, the dead rise again.

Hunting at night earns Night Watch points; the best hunters are rewarded at dawn. In Giran the Night Market opens its stalls until morning.

Type .night or open Night on the Community Board (Alt+B) to see what tonight holds.
